PWA.TITLE: Add Rikkle to Home Screen
PWA.INSTALLED_MSG: Rikkle is installed on your device!
PWA.INSTALLED_SUB: You can launch Rikkle directly from your home screen or desktop.
PWA.BENEFITS_DESC: Install Rikkle to play offline anytime, launch directly from your home screen or desktop, and enjoy fullscreen mode!
PWA.IOS_TITLE: To add Rikkle to your iPhone or iPad home screen:
PWA.IOS_STEP_1: Tap the Share button in Safari
PWA.IOS_STEP_2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen
PWA.IOS_STEP_3: Tap Add in the top-right corner
PWA.GENERIC_DESC: Install Rikkle to play offline anytime, launch from your desktop or home screen, and enjoy fullscreen gameplay!
PWA.GENERIC_HINT: Open your browser menu and select Install Rikkle or Add to Home Screen.

TUTORIAL.ROTATE_H_DESC: Swipe rows left or right to line up 3+ matching pieces, then tap any matched piece to clear them!
TUTORIAL.ROTATE_V_DESC: In horizontal levels, swipe columns up or down to align matching pieces. Swipe the background to pan.
TUTORIAL.MOVES_DEC_DESC: Each rotation uses 1 move. Match pieces before your moves run out!
TUTORIAL.MOVES_INC_DESC: Make fast matches (Speed Bonus) or match 4+ pieces (Long Match) to earn bonus moves!
TUTORIAL.POWER_MOVE_DESC: Power moves appear from 4+ matches. Tap them to clear entire rows or detonate surrounding pieces!
TUTORIAL.GAME_MENU_DESC: Access audio controls, reset high scores, and other settings here.
